notablePrerequisites:
You have basic land card in hand.
You control at least one basic land.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability by tapping it, putting a basic land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm and  Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning any other basic land from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
